intro: Sponsorship gives firms a direct, year-round presence among ACA students training across Greater Manchester, supporting the next generation of chartered accountants.

tiers.name: Headline Partner
tiers.summary: Our lead partner across the whole year, with naming on our biggest moments.
benefits: Logo first on the website, social posts and all event materials
"in partnership with" naming on the Annual Ball
Sector exclusivity: no competing firm in the same sector at any tier
Speaking slot or stand at the Ball and one other flagship event
Allocation of Ball tickets (number to be agreed)
Dedicated social media features through the year
Post-event reports and an end-of-year partnership report

tiers.name: Pillar Partner
tiers.summary: Own one pillar of the society's year and be the name members see at every event in it.
benefits: Naming on every event in your pillar (e.g. "Summer Games, supported by …")
Logo on the website and on pillar event materials
Stand, banner or short talk at your pillar's events
Social media posts for each pillar event
Post-event reports and an end-of-year report

tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.summary: Entry-level support for the society's programme for the year.
benefits: Logo and link on the website's Partners section
Mention at one event of your choice

addons.name: Annual Ball headline sponsor
addons.summary: Lead billing at our largest event. Can be combined with any tier.

addons.name: Awards category
addons.summary: Name and present one award category at the Ball.

addons.name: Single event sponsor
addons.summary: Support one social, sports or revision event.

process.title: Get in touch
process.text: Email us and we'll send the full prospectus and audience figures.

process.title: Agree a package
process.text: We tailor benefits and confirm everything in a simple 12-month agreement.

process.title: Invoice
process.text: We invoice from the society. Our charity number appears on every invoice.

process.title: Report back
process.text: You get a short report after each event you support and an end-of-year summary.
